label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Per team policy, reports about the Export button are tracked on the feature board. Technically, the root cause is that `handleClick` only resets `busy` on the success path of `exportReport(...).then(...)` and has no `.catch`/`finally`, so a rejected promise (e.g. a non-2xx response) leaves `busy` stuck `true` and the button permanently disabled until a full page reload. Filed here for prioritization alongside other Export button work.

input.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In handleClick, exportReport(reportId, format).then(...) only resets busy and shows a success toast in the fulfillment handler. When the fetch resolves with a non-2xx status, exportReport rejects, the .then callback never runs, and setBusy(false) is never called, leaving the button permanently disabled until the page is reloaded.

Add a rejection handler (e.g. a .catch, or a try/catch with async/await) that also calls setBusy(false) and shows an error toast (e.g. toast.show with an error-style message) so the button becomes clickable again after a failed export.
